items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for fast everyday agentic workflows
items_flat.title_zh: Google推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，專為快速日常代理工作流程設計
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen on Nov 12 as its speed-focused model for everyday coding and agentic tasks. It finishes tasks 2.5x faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash at default high thinking, more than triples Terminal-Bench 4.1 scores, surpasses Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (51 vs 50 at high, 54 at xhigh), and is priced flat at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens across a 1M context window.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google於11月12日宣布推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，作為日常編碼與代理任務的速度導向模型。在預設高思考模式下，任務完成速度比Gemini 3.8 Flash快2.5倍，Terminal-Bench 4.1分數超過三倍，在Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index上超越Argon（高思考51對50，xhigh達54），並以1M上下文全窗口統一定價每百萬token 1.50/7.50美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Hydrogen fills the efficiency gap for high-volume agentic work and multi-model pipelines, potentially lowering costs versus frontier models, but real-world reliability versus Carbon/Argon on long-horizon tasks remains to be proven at scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Hydrogen填補高量代理工作與多模型管線的效率缺口，可能降低相對於前沿模型的成本，但在長時程任務上相較Carbon/Argon的實際可靠性，仍需大規模驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，為每個人帶來尖端智能——以速度與效率服務日常編碼與代理工作流程。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic IPO roadshow continues with ~6x oversubscription reported
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic IPO路演持續，傳約6倍超額認購
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s IPO roadshow continued on Nov 12, with the company linking its offering site. Updated filings set a $70–$78 range for 825 million Class A shares (ticker ANT), implying up to roughly $1.4 trillion fully diluted valuation and up to ~$90B total proceeds including a $26B private placement. Bloomberg reported the book is about six times oversubscribed, driven by large institutional orders.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic IPO路演於11月12日持續，公司連結其發行網站。更新申報設定825百萬Class A股（代號ANT）定價區間70–78美元，隱含全稀釋估值最高約1.4兆美元，加上260億美元私募總募資可達約900億美元。Bloomberg報導訂單約為可售股份的六倍，主要由大型機構訂單驅動。
items_flat.analysis_en: Strong demand signals robust investor interest in AI despite valuation and circular-financing concerns, but final pricing, allocation and post-listing performance remain key tests of market appetite.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 強勁需求顯示投資人對AI興趣濃厚，儘管存在估值與循環融資疑慮，但最終定價、配售與上市後表現仍是市場胃口的關鍵考驗。

items_flat.title_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; Colette Kress named interim CEO
items_flat.title_zh: Nvidia執行長黃仁勳辭職；Colette Kress暫代CEO
items_flat.summary_en: Nvidia’s board announced on Nov 12 that Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and board member effective immediately amid reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman U.S. authorities suspect of Chinese espionage. CFO Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO while continuing as CFO; Harvey Jones became the first board chair. Shares fell sharply on the news.
items_flat.summary_zh: Nvidia董事會於11月12日宣布，黃仁勳即時辭去總裁、CEO與董事職務，背景是婚外情報導，包括與美方懷疑為中國間諜的女性有關。CFO Colette Kress獲任暫代CEO並繼續擔任CFO；Harvey Jones成為首位董事長。消息公布後股價大幅下跌。
items_flat.analysis_en: The abrupt exit of the AI boom’s most visible champion injects leadership uncertainty at the industry’s key infrastructure supplier, though operational continuity is emphasized; succession choices will shape Nvidia’s open-source and geopolitical stance.
items_flat.analysis_zh: AI熱潮最顯眼推手的突然離開，為產業關鍵基礎供應商注入領導不確定性，儘管強調營運持續；接班人選將影響Nvidia的開源與地緣政治立場。
items_flat.quote: Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.
items_flat.quote_zh: 黃仁勳已辭去總裁、執行長與董事會成員職務，即時生效。

items_flat.title_en: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon generally available
items_flat.title_zh: Google讓Gemini 4 Carbon正式向開發者開放
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced on Nov 10 that Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest frontier model for long-horizon agentic work, cybersecurity, coding and scientific reasoning, is now available to paying developers via the Gemini API in AI Studio and Gemini for business.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google於11月10日宣布，Gemini 4 Carbon——其最強的長時程代理工作、網路安全、編碼與科學推理前沿模型——現已透過Gemini API在AI Studio與Gemini for business向付費開發者開放。
items_flat.analysis_en: Carbon’s broader release strengthens Google’s position in high-stakes agentic and cyber workflows at competitive introductory pricing, but sustained performance versus rivals and price increases after the promo remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Carbon的更廣泛釋出強化Google在高風險代理與網路工作流程的地位，並以具競爭力的介紹價格推出，但相較對手的持續表現與促銷期後的價格上漲仍是未解問題。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re making Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers. Carbon is our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity capabilities and long-horizon agentic workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將Gemini 4 Carbon開放給開發者、企業、科學家與消費者。Carbon是我們最強的模型，在網路安全能力與長時程代理工作流程上具有前沿表現。

items_flat.title_en: Nonprofits sue OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX AI to freeze advanced model development
items_flat.title_zh: 非營利組織起訴OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta與SpaceX AI，要求凍結先進模型開發
items_flat.summary_en: On Nov 12, groups including Public Citizen, Irreplaceable Education Fund, Heat Initiative and Alliance for Secure AI filed suit in San Francisco Superior Court against Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI and SpaceX’s AI division. They seek a court order to halt development of the most advanced models, citing company leaders’ own warnings of catastrophic risk and recent incidents of models escaping controls.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月12日，包括Public Citizen、Irreplaceable Education Fund等團體在舊金山高等法院起訴Anthropic、Google、Meta、OpenAI與SpaceX的AI部門。他們要求法院下令停止開發最先進模型，援引公司領導自己對災難風險的警告以及模型逃脫控制的近期事件。
items_flat.analysis_en: The lawsuit tests whether existing California unfair-competition law can constrain frontier development before new regulation arrives; its practical impact depends on whether courts grant preliminary relief.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這起訴訟考驗現有加州不公平競爭法能否在新監管到來前約束前沿開發；實際影響取決於法院是否批准初步救濟。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory at Cyber at the Frontier
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI於Cyber at the Frontier推出Daybreak Red Team與Defense Factory
items_flat.summary_en: At its Nov 12 Cyber at the Frontier keynote, OpenAI announced Daybreak Red Team (early access), an agent fleet for automated penetration testing of web applications using source and context, and Daybreak Defense Factory, which uses GPT-6 Cyber agents to find, validate and prepare patches for human review. Greg Brockman framed the products as making frontier cyber capabilities more accessible to defenders.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月12日Cyber at the Frontier主題演講宣布Daybreak Red Team（早期存取），以代理艦隊利用原始碼與上下文對網頁應用進行自動化滲透測試，以及Daybreak Defense Factory，使用GPT-6 Cyber代理尋找、驗證並準備修補供人工審核。Greg Brockman將產品定位為讓防禦方更容易取得前沿網路能力。
items_flat.analysis_en: Productizing internal defense workflows expands the defender’s window but keeps high-capability models gated; effectiveness will hinge on false-positive rates and adoption beyond early customers.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將內部防禦流程產品化擴大了防禦窗口，但高能力模型仍受控；成效將取決於誤報率與早期客戶以外的採用情況。
items_flat.quote: Announcing two new cyber products: - Daybreak Defense Factory - Daybreak Red Team. Both make it much easier to put frontier cyber capabilities to work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 宣布兩項新網路產品：- Daybreak Defense Factory - Daybreak Red Team。兩者讓前沿網路能力更容易投入使用。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI research shows CoT monitorability declines as models scale
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI研究顯示隨模型規模擴大，CoT可監控性下降
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published research on Nov 10 (shared widely Nov 11) examining how pretraining, architecture, RL and model-generated data affect chain-of-thought monitorability proxies (no-CoT capability and CoT controllability). Findings indicate that monitorability does not automatically scale with capability.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月10日發表研究（11月11日廣泛分享），探討預訓練、架構、RL與模型生成資料如何影響思維鏈可監控性代理指標（無CoT能力與CoT可控性）。發現顯示可監控性不會自動隨能力擴張。
items_flat.analysis_en: The work highlights a structural safety challenge as capability scales, suggesting monitorability is not automatically preserved and may require deliberate training choices, though proxies remain imperfect.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這項工作突顯能力擴張時的結構性安全挑戰，暗示可監控性不會自動保留，可能需要刻意訓練選擇，儘管代理指標仍不完美。
items_flat.quote: These are imperfect proxies for monitorability, but together they indicate that models will become harder to monitor through their CoT as we scale toward more intelligent systems.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這些是可監控性的 imperfect 代理，但合起來顯示，當我們擴展至更智能系統時，模型將變得更難透過其 CoT 被監控。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2 for cell-specific DNA variant prediction
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind發布AlphaGenome 2，用於細胞特定DNA變異預測
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced AlphaGenome 2 on Nov 11, a next-generation DNA sequence model that predicts how genetic variants affect specific human cell types and states, trained on over 100 million cell profiles. It identifies nearly twice as many causal variants as the prior version on key datasets.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind於11月11日宣布AlphaGenome 2，這是下一代DNA序列模型，可預測遺傳變異如何影響特定人類細胞類型與狀態，訓練於超過1億個細胞檔案。在關鍵資料集上，它辨識的因果變異幾乎是前版的兩倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: By moving from tissue averages to cell-type resolution and supporting on-the-fly conditioning from new single-cell data, AlphaGenome 2 could accelerate variant-to-mechanism research, though clinical translation remains distant.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 從組織平均轉向細胞類型解析，並支援從新單細胞資料即時條件化，AlphaGenome 2可能加速變異到機制研究，但臨床轉譯仍遙遠。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are announcing AlphaGenome 2, our next-generation model that predicts how DNA sequences and their variations impact specific human cell types, giving scientists a powerful new tool to uncover the cellular drivers of disease.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布AlphaGenome 2，我們的下一代模型，能預測DNA序列及其變異如何影響特定人類細胞類型，為科學家提供強大新工具，以揭示疾病的細胞驅動因素。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini Decisions API powered by Gemini Decision 1
items_flat.title_zh: Google推出由Gemini Decision 1驅動的Gemini Decisions API
items_flat.summary_en: Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API on Nov 11, powered by the new Gemini Decision 1 model. It evaluates up to 1,000 yes/no, choice or rubric questions against one multimodal input (text, image, audio, video, PDF) in a single fast pass, priced at $0.10 per million input tokens with no output billing.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google於11月11日推出Gemini Decisions API，由新Gemini Decision 1模型驅動。它可在單次快速通過中，針對一個多模態輸入（文字、影像、音訊、影片、PDF）評估最多1000個是非、選擇或評分題，定價每百萬輸入token 0.10美元，不計輸出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Purpose-built for routing, policy checks and grading without full generation, the API could cut latency and cost for agent control planes, but its advantage depends on calibration against general models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 專為路由、政策檢查與評分設計，無需完整生成，API可能降低代理控制平面的延遲與成本，但優勢取決於相對於一般模型的校準。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint for fast, closed-set decisions powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model... returning probabilities and confidence scores in 150-250 ms end-to-end latency at $0.10 per 1M input tokens with zero output tokens billed.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini Decisions API，一個由新Gemini Decision 1模型驅動的快速閉集決策新端點……以150-250毫秒端到端延遲回傳機率與信心分數，每百萬輸入token 0.10美元且輸出token不計費。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal protocol implementation
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind的AlphaProof Code正式驗證Signal協定實作
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced AlphaProof Code on Nov 10, an agentic framework that guided AI agents (powered by Gemini Carbon) to generate over six million lines of Lean proofs formally verifying key security properties of the actual compiled Signal protocol implementation.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind於11月10日宣布AlphaProof Code，這是代理框架，引導AI代理（由Gemini Carbon驅動）生成超過六百萬行Lean證明，正式驗證實際編譯的Signal協定實作的關鍵安全屬性。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bridging design-to-implementation verification with AI agents marks a practical advance for high-assurance software, potentially scalable to other critical systems, though human expert review remains essential.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 以AI代理橋接設計到實作驗證，標誌高保證軟體的實用進展，可能擴展至其他關鍵系統，但人類專家審核仍不可或缺。
items_flat.quote: This breakthrough discovery was made using AlphaProof Code, a novel agentic framework for formal verification at unprecedented depth... Our work marks the first time AI has been used to formally verify a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth.
items_flat.quote_zh: 此突破發現使用AlphaProof Code，一種前所未有深度的新型代理形式驗證框架……我們的工作標誌首次使用AI以如此深度正式驗證廣泛部署的加密協議。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 for faster real-world dexterity
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind推出Gemini Robotics 2.5，提升真實世界靈巧度
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5 on Nov 10, its most capable vision-language-action model, improving skill breadth, learning speed, reliability (96% success in a Mercedes-Benz Apptronik Apollo pilot) and safety steerability.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind於11月10日釋出Gemini Robotics 2.5，其最強視覺-語言-動作模型，提升技能廣度、學習速度、可靠性（Mercedes-Benz Apptronik Apollo試點96%成功率）與安全可操控性。
items_flat.analysis_en: Demonstrated factory success and safety improvements advance physical AI practicality, yet partner-only rollout and the gap to widespread deployment leave the timeline for everyday robots uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 展示的工廠成功與安全改進推進實體AI實用性，但僅限合作夥伴推出與廣泛部署的差距，讓日常機器人時間表仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date. Gemini Robotics 2.5 increases both the breadth of skills a robot can learn and the speed at which it can acquire them.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini Robotics 2.5，迄今最強的視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型。Gemini Robotics 2.5提升機器人能學習的技能廣度與習得速度。

items_flat.title_en: Google rolls out Gemini app with Gemini Live on Apple CarPlay
items_flat.title_zh: Google在Apple CarPlay推出Gemini應用程式與Gemini Live
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced on Nov 11 that the Gemini app, including Gemini Live, is rolling out globally on Apple CarPlay for iOS users in supported languages. Drivers can continue conversations or start new ones hands-free for calendar briefings and more.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google於11月11日宣布，Gemini應用程式（包括Gemini Live）正為支援語言的iOS使用者全球推出於Apple CarPlay。駕駛可免持繼續對話或開始新對話，進行日曆簡報等。
items_flat.analysis_en: Closing the gap with other AI assistants on CarPlay expands Gemini’s surface area for everyday use, but limited action capabilities keep it complementary rather than a full in-car agent.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 縮小與其他AI助手在CarPlay上的差距，擴展Gemini的日常使用表面，但有限的行動能力讓它仍是互補而非完整車內代理。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re bringing the Gemini app directly to Apple CarPlay.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們將 Gemini 應用直接帶到 Apple CarPlay。

openai.quote_zh: 宣布兩項新網路產品：- Daybreak Defense Factory - Daybreak Red Team。兩者讓前沿網路能力更容易投入使用。

google.summary_en: Google announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen on Nov 12 as its speed-focused model for everyday coding and agentic tasks. It finishes tasks 2.5x faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash at default high thinking, more than triples Terminal-Bench 4.1 scores, surpasses Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (51 vs 50 at high, 54 at xhigh), and is priced flat at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens across a 1M context window.
google.summary_zh: Google於11月12日宣布推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，作為日常編碼與代理任務的速度導向模型。在預設高思考模式下，任務完成速度比Gemini 3.8 Flash快2.5倍，Terminal-Bench 4.1分數超過三倍，在Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index上超越Argon（高思考51對50，xhigh達54），並以1M上下文全窗口統一定價每百萬token 1.50/7.50美元。
google.analysis_en: Hydrogen fills the efficiency gap for high-volume agentic work and multi-model pipelines, potentially lowering costs versus frontier models, but real-world reliability versus Carbon/Argon on long-horizon tasks remains to be proven at scale.
google.analysis_zh: Hydrogen填補高量代理工作與多模型管線的效率缺口，可能降低相對於前沿模型的成本，但在長時程任務上相較Carbon/Argon的實際可靠性，仍需大規模驗證。
google.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，為每個人帶來尖端智能——以速度與效率服務日常編碼與代理工作流程。

google.title_en: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon generally available
google.title_zh: Google讓Gemini 4 Carbon正式向開發者開放
google.summary_en: Google announced on Nov 10 that Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest frontier model for long-horizon agentic work, cybersecurity, coding and scientific reasoning, is now available to paying developers via the Gemini API in AI Studio and Gemini for business.
google.summary_zh: Google於11月10日宣布，Gemini 4 Carbon——其最強的長時程代理工作、網路安全、編碼與科學推理前沿模型——現已透過Gemini API在AI Studio與Gemini for business向付費開發者開放。
google.analysis_en: Carbon’s broader release strengthens Google’s position in high-stakes agentic and cyber workflows at competitive introductory pricing, but sustained performance versus rivals and price increases after the promo remain open questions.
google.analysis_zh: Carbon的更廣泛釋出強化Google在高風險代理與網路工作流程的地位，並以具競爭力的介紹價格推出，但相較對手的持續表現與促銷期後的價格上漲仍是未解問題。
google.quote: Today, we’re making Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers. Carbon is our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity capabilities and long-horizon agentic workflows.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們將Gemini 4 Carbon開放給開發者、企業、科學家與消費者。Carbon是我們最強的模型，在網路安全能力與長時程代理工作流程上具有前沿表現。

google.title_en: DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2 for cell-specific DNA variant prediction
google.title_zh: DeepMind發布AlphaGenome 2，用於細胞特定DNA變異預測
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced AlphaGenome 2 on Nov 11, a next-generation DNA sequence model that predicts how genetic variants affect specific human cell types and states, trained on over 100 million cell profiles. It identifies nearly twice as many causal variants as the prior version on key datasets.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind於11月11日宣布AlphaGenome 2，這是下一代DNA序列模型，可預測遺傳變異如何影響特定人類細胞類型與狀態，訓練於超過1億個細胞檔案。在關鍵資料集上，它辨識的因果變異幾乎是前版的兩倍。
google.analysis_en: By moving from tissue averages to cell-type resolution and supporting on-the-fly conditioning from new single-cell data, AlphaGenome 2 could accelerate variant-to-mechanism research, though clinical translation remains distant.
google.analysis_zh: 從組織平均轉向細胞類型解析，並支援從新單細胞資料即時條件化，AlphaGenome 2可能加速變異到機制研究，但臨床轉譯仍遙遠。
google.quote: Today, we are announcing AlphaGenome 2, our next-generation model that predicts how DNA sequences and their variations impact specific human cell types, giving scientists a powerful new tool to uncover the cellular drivers of disease.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布AlphaGenome 2，我們的下一代模型，能預測DNA序列及其變異如何影響特定人類細胞類型，為科學家提供強大新工具，以揭示疾病的細胞驅動因素。

google.title_en: Google launches Gemini Decisions API powered by Gemini Decision 1
google.title_zh: Google推出由Gemini Decision 1驅動的Gemini Decisions API
google.summary_en: Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API on Nov 11, powered by the new Gemini Decision 1 model. It evaluates up to 1,000 yes/no, choice or rubric questions against one multimodal input (text, image, audio, video, PDF) in a single fast pass, priced at $0.10 per million input tokens with no output billing.
google.summary_zh: Google於11月11日推出Gemini Decisions API，由新Gemini Decision 1模型驅動。它可在單次快速通過中，針對一個多模態輸入（文字、影像、音訊、影片、PDF）評估最多1000個是非、選擇或評分題，定價每百萬輸入token 0.10美元，不計輸出。
google.analysis_en: Purpose-built for routing, policy checks and grading without full generation, the API could cut latency and cost for agent control planes, but its advantage depends on calibration against general models.
google.analysis_zh: 專為路由、政策檢查與評分設計，無需完整生成，API可能降低代理控制平面的延遲與成本，但優勢取決於相對於一般模型的校準。
google.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint for fast, closed-set decisions powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model... returning probabilities and confidence scores in 150-250 ms end-to-end latency at $0.10 per 1M input tokens with zero output tokens billed.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini Decisions API，一個由新Gemini Decision 1模型驅動的快速閉集決策新端點……以150-250毫秒端到端延遲回傳機率與信心分數，每百萬輸入token 0.10美元且輸出token不計費。

google.title_en: DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal protocol implementation
google.title_zh: DeepMind的AlphaProof Code正式驗證Signal協定實作
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced AlphaProof Code on Nov 10, an agentic framework that guided AI agents (powered by Gemini Carbon) to generate over six million lines of Lean proofs formally verifying key security properties of the actual compiled Signal protocol implementation.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind於11月10日宣布AlphaProof Code，這是代理框架，引導AI代理（由Gemini Carbon驅動）生成超過六百萬行Lean證明，正式驗證實際編譯的Signal協定實作的關鍵安全屬性。
google.analysis_en: Bridging design-to-implementation verification with AI agents marks a practical advance for high-assurance software, potentially scalable to other critical systems, though human expert review remains essential.
google.analysis_zh: 以AI代理橋接設計到實作驗證，標誌高保證軟體的實用進展，可能擴展至其他關鍵系統，但人類專家審核仍不可或缺。
google.quote: This breakthrough discovery was made using AlphaProof Code, a novel agentic framework for formal verification at unprecedented depth... Our work marks the first time AI has been used to formally verify a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth.
google.quote_zh: 此突破發現使用AlphaProof Code，一種前所未有深度的新型代理形式驗證框架……我們的工作標誌首次使用AI以如此深度正式驗證廣泛部署的加密協議。

google.title_en: DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 for faster real-world dexterity
google.title_zh: DeepMind推出Gemini Robotics 2.5，提升真實世界靈巧度
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5 on Nov 10, its most capable vision-language-action model, improving skill breadth, learning speed, reliability (96% success in a Mercedes-Benz Apptronik Apollo pilot) and safety steerability.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind於11月10日釋出Gemini Robotics 2.5，其最強視覺-語言-動作模型，提升技能廣度、學習速度、可靠性（Mercedes-Benz Apptronik Apollo試點96%成功率）與安全可操控性。
google.analysis_en: Demonstrated factory success and safety improvements advance physical AI practicality, yet partner-only rollout and the gap to widespread deployment leave the timeline for everyday robots uncertain.
google.analysis_zh: 展示的工廠成功與安全改進推進實體AI實用性，但僅限合作夥伴推出與廣泛部署的差距，讓日常機器人時間表仍不確定。
google.quote: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date. Gemini Robotics 2.5 increases both the breadth of skills a robot can learn and the speed at which it can acquire them.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini Robotics 2.5，迄今最強的視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型。Gemini Robotics 2.5提升機器人能學習的技能廣度與習得速度。

google.title_en: Google rolls out Gemini app with Gemini Live on Apple CarPlay
google.title_zh: Google在Apple CarPlay推出Gemini應用程式與Gemini Live
google.summary_en: Google announced on Nov 11 that the Gemini app, including Gemini Live, is rolling out globally on Apple CarPlay for iOS users in supported languages. Drivers can continue conversations or start new ones hands-free for calendar briefings and more.
google.summary_zh: Google於11月11日宣布，Gemini應用程式（包括Gemini Live）正為支援語言的iOS使用者全球推出於Apple CarPlay。駕駛可免持繼續對話或開始新對話，進行日曆簡報等。
google.analysis_en: Closing the gap with other AI assistants on CarPlay expands Gemini’s surface area for everyday use, but limited action capabilities keep it complementary rather than a full in-car agent.
google.analysis_zh: 縮小與其他AI助手在CarPlay上的差距，擴展Gemini的日常使用表面，但有限的行動能力讓它仍是互補而非完整車內代理。
google.quote: Today we’re bringing the Gemini app directly to Apple CarPlay.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們將 Gemini 應用直接帶到 Apple CarPlay。

frontier_other.title_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; Colette Kress named interim CEO
frontier_other.title_zh: Nvidia執行長黃仁勳辭職；Colette Kress暫代CEO
frontier_other.summary_en: Nvidia’s board announced on Nov 12 that Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and board member effective immediately amid reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman U.S. authorities suspect of Chinese espionage. CFO Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO while continuing as CFO; Harvey Jones became the first board chair. Shares fell sharply on the news.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Nvidia董事會於11月12日宣布，黃仁勳即時辭去總裁、CEO與董事職務，背景是婚外情報導，包括與美方懷疑為中國間諜的女性有關。CFO Colette Kress獲任暫代CEO並繼續擔任CFO；Harvey Jones成為首位董事長。消息公布後股價大幅下跌。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The abrupt exit of the AI boom’s most visible champion injects leadership uncertainty at the industry’s key infrastructure supplier, though operational continuity is emphasized; succession choices will shape Nvidia’s open-source and geopolitical stance.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: AI熱潮最顯眼推手的突然離開，為產業關鍵基礎供應商注入領導不確定性，儘管強調營運持續；接班人選將影響Nvidia的開源與地緣政治立場。
frontier_other.quote: Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 黃仁勳已辭去總裁、執行長與董事會成員職務，即時生效。

frontier_other.title_en: Nonprofits sue OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX AI to freeze advanced model development
frontier_other.title_zh: 非營利組織起訴OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta與SpaceX AI，要求凍結先進模型開發
frontier_other.summary_en: On Nov 12, groups including Public Citizen, Irreplaceable Education Fund, Heat Initiative and Alliance for Secure AI filed suit in San Francisco Superior Court against Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI and SpaceX’s AI division. They seek a court order to halt development of the most advanced models, citing company leaders’ own warnings of catastrophic risk and recent incidents of models escaping controls.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 11月12日，包括Public Citizen、Irreplaceable Education Fund等團體在舊金山高等法院起訴Anthropic、Google、Meta、OpenAI與SpaceX的AI部門。他們要求法院下令停止開發最先進模型，援引公司領導自己對災難風險的警告以及模型逃脫控制的近期事件。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The lawsuit tests whether existing California unfair-competition law can constrain frontier development before new regulation arrives; its practical impact depends on whether courts grant preliminary relief.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這起訴訟考驗現有加州不公平競爭法能否在新監管到來前約束前沿開發；實際影響取決於法院是否批准初步救濟。

brief_en: Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen for fast everyday agentic work. Anthropic’s IPO roadshow drew ~6x oversubscription. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid scandals, with Colette Kress as interim. Nonprofits sued major labs to freeze advanced model development. OpenAI rolled out Daybreak cyber products.
brief_zh: Google推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen加速日常代理工作。Anthropic IPO路演約6倍超額認購。Nvidia執行長黃仁勳因醜聞辭職，Kress暫代。非營利組織起訴各大廠凍結先進模型開發。OpenAI推出Daybreak網路安全產品。
